description: Fetch one or more CVEs by ID from the NIST National Vulnerability Database. Returns CVSS scores across all available versions (v2.0, v3.0, v3.1, v4.0) with who supplied each, CWE weakness classifications, affected CPE configurations from NVD analysis, the affected products the CNA and any ADP state themselves, the record's source and tags, CISA KEV fields, current SSVC assessments, and references. Up to 100 distinct CVE IDs per call. For bulk lookups of more than 10 IDs, use brief: true — full records for 100 CVEs can exceed 1MB and exhaust context budgets.

allLanguages.description: When true, keeps every localized description NVD supplies on each record, and full records render all of them. Default keeps English only, falling back to whatever exists if a record has no English entry. Brief records always carry a single truncated description.

brief.description: When true, returns trimmed records (ID, status, top CVSS score, KEV name, published date, and a truncated description) instead of full detail. Recommended for batches of more than 10 IDs.

anyOf.description: One CVE ID, or several separated by commas or whitespace (e.g., "CVE-2024-3400,CVE-2024-6387"), handled exactly as the array form.

An array of CVE IDs — at least 1; an element is never split. IDs match regardless of case and a repeat is fetched once. The first 100 distinct IDs are processed; excess IDs are reported unless NVD_CLAMP_LIMITS is false, which rejects them.

cveIds.description: One CVE ID, a comma- or whitespace-separated list of them, or an array; at most 100 distinct IDs are fetched per call.

includeAffected.description: When false, omits affectedProducts from full records and their rendered text.

includeConfigurations.description: When false, omits configurationNodes from full records and their rendered text.

includeReferences.description: When false, omits the references array to reduce response size.

name: nvd_get_cve

brief.description: Whether brief or full records were returned.

cves.description: CVE records — full detail by default, trimmed rows when brief is true.

items.description: One CVE record. Every field beyond cveId, vulnStatus, and published depends on the mode: full mode (the default) carries all of them except description and cisaVulnerabilityName, which are the brief-mode substitutes for descriptions and cisaKev.

affectedProducts.description: Affected products as the CNA and any ADP state them, one entry per product — their own statement, not NVD analysis, and often the only product and version evidence on a record NVD has not analyzed. Read versions with versionChanges and defaultStatus. Empty when no contributor sent any.

collectionURL.description: Package collection that gives packageName its meaning (e.g. a registry URL).

cpes.description: CPE names the contributor attached to this product.

defaultStatus.description: Status of every version the versions list does not cover: affected, unaffected, or unknown. Absent when the contributor stated none, which the CVE schema reads as unknown.

platforms.description: Platforms the statement is limited to. Absent means every relevant platform.

source.description: Who made this statement — the CNA or an ADP — as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CISA-ADP"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "security@apache.org"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value.

vendor.description: Vendor, project, or maintainer of the product.

versionChanges.description: Status changes inside version ranges, moved out of their range so each stays addressable; versionIndex names the range. Within one range, sort by version under its versionType before applying them.

items.description: One status change inside a version range.

at.description: Version at which the status changes.

status.description: Status from this version on, until the next change or the range end.

versionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the versions entry whose range this change is inside.

versions.description: Versions and ranges with their status, in the order the contributor listed them. A range can change status partway through; versionChanges carries those points.

lessThan.description: Exclusive upper bound of the range.

lessThanOrEqual.description: Inclusive upper bound of the range.

status.description: Status of this version or range: affected, unaffected, or unknown.

version.description: A single version, or the inclusive lower bound of a range.

versionType.description: Version scheme a range is compared under (e.g. "semver", "git", "custom"). Absent on a single version.

cisaKev.description: CISA KEV fields. Present only when CVE is in the KEV catalog.

exploitAddDate.description: Date added to CISA KEV catalog.

cisaVulnerabilityName.description: CISA KEV vulnerability name. Present only when in the KEV catalog.

configurationNodes.description: Affected product configuration nodes. NVD nests these under configuration groups; the groups are represented by groupIndex so each node's own criteria stay together.

items.description: One affected product configuration node, tagged with the group it came from.

cpeMatch.description: This node's CPE match criteria, in the order NVD lists them.

vulnerable.description: Whether this CPE is the vulnerable component or only the context it runs in.

groupIndex.description: Zero-based index of the NVD configuration group this node belongs to. Nodes sharing a groupIndex were siblings in one group, combined by groupOperator.

groupOperator.description: Logical operator (AND/OR) combining this node with its sibling nodes in the same group. An "AND" means every node in the group must match for the CVE to apply — e.g. a firmware node and the hardware it runs on. Absent when the group has nothing to combine.

nodeOperator.description: Logical operator (AND/OR) combining this node's own criteria below. Absent when the node has nothing to combine.

cveTags.description: Tags contributors attached to the CVE. Absent when none did.

source.description: Who attached the tags, as the contributor name NVD publishes for it; email-form identifiers keep their address.

cvssScores.description: All available CVSS scores across versions.

severity.description: Severity label: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW.

source.description: Who supplied the score, as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CISA-ADP"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "nvd@nist.gov"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value. Absent when NVD names no source.

sourceType.description: NVD's label for this score, "Primary" or "Secondary". It does not say who scored it — a CNA's score can be Primary and an ADP's Secondary; source names the scorer.

description.description: Opening 200 characters of the English CVE description, truncated with an ellipsis when longer. Enough to tell one result from another; call nvd_get_cve for the full text. Absent when NVD carries no description for the record.

source.description: Who contributed the reference, as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CVE", "CISA-ADP"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "security@apache.org"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value.

severity.description: Top severity. Absent if no CVSS scores present.

fromVersion.description: Which CVSS version this top score came from.

label.description: Highest severity label across all CVSS versions.

sourceIdentifier.description: The contributor NVD lists as the record's source — the CNA that submitted it — as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CPANSec"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "cve@mitre.org"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value.

ssvc.description: Current SSVC assessments in upstream order.

decisionPoints.description: Ordered option objects; repeated keys remain separate.

additionalProperties.description: One string or ordered list of strings.

source.description: Contributor name or original source identifier.

Who classified the weakness, as the contributor name NVD publishes for it (e.g. "CVE", "CISA-ADP"). Contributors NVD identifies by email address keep that address (e.g. "nvd@nist.gov"); an identifier absent from NVD's contributor dictionary passes through as its raw value.

effectiveLimit.description: Page size or ID count used after clamping.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `nvd_invalid_response`: NVD returned an invalid response. `nvd_request_blocked`: NVD blocked the request. `invalid_cve_id_format`: One or more CVE IDs fail format validation (NVD returns HTTP 404 for malformed IDs). `too_many_cve_ids`: A cveIds string names more than 100 distinct IDs and the server rejects oversized requests (NVD_CLAMP_LIMITS=false). `cve_not_found`: A valid-format CVE ID returns no results — the ID is well-formed but does not exist in NVD. `rate_limited`: NVD explicitly reported that the rate limit was exceeded. `nvd_unavailable`: NVD answered with HTTP 5xx, or the request or its response failed on the network, after the client retried. `nvd_timeout`: An NVD request outlived its timeout, or the call ran out of its 55-second deadline. `nvd_invalid_api_key`: NVD refused the server's configured NVD_API_KEY. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

missingIds.description: CVE IDs requested but not found in NVD. Absent when all IDs matched.

items.description: A CVE ID not found in NVD.

notice.description: Explains when the requested ID count was clamped.

requested.description: Number of distinct CVE IDs processed in this call.

requestedLimit.description: Requested page size, or distinct ID count, before clamping.

unprocessedIds.description: IDs beyond the processed prefix, deduplicated in request order and excluding IDs already attempted.

title: Get CVE Details
